title: DataLoader timeout for child Process
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

torch DataLoader当num_workers > 0时，如果某个子进程卡住了，主进程就会hang。那么可以在子进程读数据的时候加一个timeout机制吗？一旦子进程读数据超时，就给主进程发送信号，终止程序。这样当触发超时的时候，子进程可以保存一些信息用于debug。或者有其他更好的办法吗？

error_description: When torch DataLoader has num_workers > 0, if a child process gets stuck, the main process will hang. Can we add a timeout mechanism when the child process reads data? Once the child process reading data times out, send a signal to the main process to terminate the program. This way, when a timeout is triggered, the child process can save some information for debugging. Or is there a better way?
